name: sample_metadata_olm
description: Sample metadata from the Olm lab Microbiome Repo (pinned release), one row per field, with Olm's route and confidence; no evidence quotes. Attribution required: Microbiome Repo, OlmLab, release R2026.25 (data package 1.20.0), doi:10.5281/zenodo.23087712; values derived. Required attribution for the CC-BY-4.0 tables.
grain: one row per sample, field and Olm sample

columns.name: sample_key
columns.description: The id the registration published the sample under: a readset id (RS.…) for new registrations, the md5 sample_id for cmgd_nextflow 2.2.1.

columns.name: field
columns.description: Metadata field: the harmonized name (age_years, sex, country, bmi, antibiotics_current_use, health_condition) where mapped, else the source's own.

columns.name: value
columns.description: Marker abundance as reported by MetaPhlAn.

columns.name: source_field
columns.description: The field name as the source spells it.

columns.name: value_raw
columns.description: The value exactly as the source gives it.

columns.name: value_unit
columns.description: The source's unit for value_raw, when it gives one.

columns.name: confidence
columns.description: Source-reported confidence (Olm routes R3/R4); NULL for curated values.

columns.name: route
columns.description: How the value was determined: 'curated' (cMD) or Olm's route R1-R4.

columns.name: evidence_source
columns.description: Olm evidence source (external.cmd = imported from cMD).

columns.name: biosample
columns.description: INSDC BioSample accession(s), semicolon-separated (NULL if not yet known).

columns.name: source
columns.description: Metadata source: cmd (curatedMetagenomicData curation) or olm (Microbiome Repo).

columns.name: release
columns.description: Source release: cMD curation commit, or Olm release id.

columns.name: source_sample
columns.description: The source's own sample id (cMD sample_id, Olm sample_key).
